description:
A quick way to check your connection speed, inside the chat.

Just ask ChatGPT for a speed test, and after it runs, discuss the results.

e.g.

- "@0-100 WiFi Internet Speed Test, test my WiFi speed"
- "@0-100 WiFi Internet Speed Test, how fast is my internet"
- "@0-100 WiFi Internet Speed Test, check my broadband"
- "@0-100 WiFi Internet Speed Test, what is my 5G speed?"

Tests download, upload, ping and jitter
